title: Metamorphic Petrology
description: Bury a rock and it changes without melting: its minerals regrow as the ones stable at the new pressure and temperature. Every boundary on that map has a slope set by how much the change gains in entropy and loses in volume. Unlocks the Tectonic Press.

puzzle.goal: Two minerals share a boundary on the pressure-temperature map. Turning the first into the second changes its entropy from S _ 1 to S _ 2 and its molar volume from V _ 1 to V _ 2. Write s, how many pascals the boundary climbs for each kelvin.
puzzle.name: Clapeyron slope
puzzle.ask: Find s in Pa/K for graphite into diamond: A = @{A}, B = @{B} J/(mol·K); X = 5.30e-6, Y = @{Y} m³/mol.
puzzle.method: Along the boundary both phases have the same Gibbs energy, so their changes match: V₁dP − S₁dT = V₂dP − S₂dT.
